referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A centered conversion opening over a wide water photograph: a short promise, an email field, and a submit button. A small top bar carries the brand and a Sign Up action. Three feature icons follow, then alternating image-and-copy rows, a testimonial row, a second centered signup band, and a compact footer. The palette is white, blue, and deep water blue. The typography is a neutral sans with large centered headings.
